facts.business: Elegant Marbles & Grani Industries Limited is a leading importer and manufacturer of premium Italian and exotic marble and granite, sourcing hand-selected slabs from 30 countries for high-end residential and commercial projects.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Key Audit Matter regarding investment in debentures of Green Farm Tech Pvt. Ltd., Fortuna Buildcon (India) Pvt. Ltd., Diyug Construction Pvt. Ltd., Shashwati Realty Pvt. Ltd., and BCIL Red Earth Developers India Pvt. Ltd. where interest and principal are not being received on due dates; management has not made additional provision beyond earlier years, deferring assessment till final realisation/legal proceedings. Auditor unable to comment on recoverability due to absence of independent valuation of underlying assets.

key_risks: Volatility in global financial markets and geopolitical developments impacting investment portfolio valuations
Non-recovery of interest and principal on debenture investments in certain real estate companies facing financial/liquidity crunch and legal cases
Dependence on fund managers/PMS managers for updates on recoverability of debenture investments
Competitive business environment in marble and granite industry
facts.related_party_note: All contracts/arrangements/transactions with related parties were in the ordinary course of business and on an arm's length basis. No material related party transactions as per Regulation 23 of SEBI LODR. Details disclosed in financial statements.
